what_differs: In the 2026-08-18 client sync, Joyce and Strahinja agreed that creating a rep in the CMS is the event that pushes rep information to Salesforce, and that the CMS sets the external ID by email match after the Salesforce user exists. WAGR-390 (Open, Kobi) says no CMS-to-Salesforce BA intake is built or scoped and the external ID is entered manually on both sides; WAGR-183 says the opposite (created upstream via CMS). No ticket exists for the agreed CMS push.
suggested_action: Suggestion only: confirm with WagerTech (Emily/Strahinja) whether the 2026-08-18 rep-creation push was replaced by the manual process in Emily's September written feedback. If the push stands, add a ticket for the Salesforce-side handling (match by email, set Rep/BA External ID, flag when no match); if not, record the reversal in WAGR-390 and correct WAGR-183.
